+# Connected nonnegative conductances on the original finite vertex set
+
+## Abstract
+
+Original harmonic-current resistance and mean-zero Rayleigh spectral interfaces.
+
+All matrices use counting measure on Fin n. The weighted Laplacian, lambda2, Harmonic, effRes and totalRes are the original FiedlerResistanceInvariantWeightsRefutation objects. The sum is over all unordered distinct original vertex pairs, including nonedges. The matrix inverse supplies harmonic voltage and current; a spectral statistic is never used as a replacement definition of resistance. These are repository-derived interfaces consuming the original generic K2m supplier bodies and the pinned Hermitian spectral theorem, with no external novelty claim.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Nonnegative conductances give the native positive semidefinite Laplacian).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.lap_psd`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.lap_psd` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every n, simple graph G on Fin n with decidable adjacency and total real Sym2 weight function w, coordinatewise nonnegativity on the actual edges implies that wLap G w is positive semidefinite. The proof derives the general double edge-energy identity; unused nonedge coordinates remain unrestricted.
+
+**Theorem 1.2 (Harmonic resistance equals the full native reciprocal spectrum).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.resistance_spectral`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.resistance_spectral` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For n positive, every G and real w, if L=wLap G w is positive semidefinite and L+constProj n is positive definite, then the existing harmonic-current totalRes G w equals n times the sum of inverses of all native Hermitian eigenvalues of L. Zero eigenvalues have inverse zero. The proof constructs the unique harmonic extension at every distinct original pair from the inverse of L+constProj, identifies its positive current, sums all unordered original pairs including nonedges once, and directly applies the existing AlbrightKemenyEdgeDerivativeRefutation reciprocalRoots_eq_trace and reciprocalRoots_eq_sum suppliers.
+
+**Theorem 1.3 (Positive connected conductances give the invertible shifted matrix).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.positive_shift`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.positive_shift` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For n positive, connected G and every w strictly positive on the original edges, L+constProj n is positive definite. A zero weighted edge energy forces equality of coordinates along every reachable path, hence a constant vector; the constant projection controls the remaining direction.
+
+**Theorem 1.4 (Exactly one native zero eigenvalue).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.zero_count`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.zero_count` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For n positive and every G,w with L+constProj n positive definite, exactly one index of the actual Hermitian eigenvalue enumeration has eigenvalue zero. The proof diagonalizes the original constant projector in the same eigenvector basis and uses its trace one.
+
+**Theorem 1.5 (A centered matrix inequality bounds the actual Rayleigh quotient).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.psd_rayleigh`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.psd_rayleigh` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For arbitrary n,G,w,t, positive semidefiniteness of L-t*(I-constProj n) implies t*dotProduct x x at most dotProduct x (L*x) for every x whose coordinate sum is zero.
+
+**Theorem 1.6 (The actual mean-zero infimum is the positive spectral minimum).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.lambda_spectral`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.lambda_spectral` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For n at least two, every G,w with L positive semidefinite and L+constProj n positive definite, the actual lambda2 G w is positive; L-lambda2*(I-constProj n) is positive semidefinite; and every nonzero native eigenvalue is at least lambda2. The least nonzero indexed eigenvalue and its mean-zero eigenvector are certified with the original lambda2_eq_of_rayleigh.
+
+**Theorem 1.7 (Actual normalization excludes a disconnected kernel).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.normalized_shift`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.normalized_shift` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For n positive, L positive semidefinite and actual lambda2 G w equal to one imply L+constProj n positive definite. The infimum bounds every mean-zero vector, and centering an arbitrary vector gives the required matrix inequality.
+
+**Definition 1.8 (The positive support keeps every original vertex).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.support`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.support` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For arbitrary n,G,w, support G w has the same vertex set Fin n and adjacency G.Adj i j together with strict positivity of w on that original edge. There is no contraction or deletion of zero-degree vertices.
+
+**Theorem 1.9 (Nonnegative normalized support is connected).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.connected_of_shift`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.connected_of_shift` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For n positive, nonnegative weights on the original edges and positive definiteness of L+constProj n imply connectedness of support G w. The indicator of a hypothetical reachability component lies in the original Laplacian kernel; the shifted inverse forces it to be constant.
+
+**Theorem 1.10 (A single excess eigenvalue forces a rank-one original matrix).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.rankone_of_spectrum`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceConnectedSpectral.rankone_of_spectrum` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For n positive, arbitrary G,w with L+constProj n positive definite, t positive, and one native eigenvalue equal to 2*t while every other native eigenvalue is zero or t, there exists a real vector v on all original vertices with sum zero and squared counting norm one such that L-t*(I-constProj n)=t*vecMulVec v v, and this actual matrix has rank one. The proof conjugates the original matrix in its native unitary eigenbasis; it imposes no part-subspace invariance or rank premise.

+# Original tripartite conductances, trace compression and boundary rigidity
+
+## Abstract
+
+The complete strict Fiedler resistance bound and unique balanced boundary on original labelled tripartite graphs.
+
+The original parts are the successive intervals of lengths a,b,c in Fin(a+b+c). Every original cross-part edge has its own independent finite real conductance. The competitor domain has no symmetry, invariant-subspace, trace or rank premise. The matrix is the existing counting-measure wLap, lambda2 is its existing nonzero mean-zero Rayleigh infimum, and totalRes is the existing harmonic-current resistance summed once over every unordered distinct original vertex pair, including nonedges. Arbitrary values on unused nonedge coordinates do not enter any uniqueness claim. The source is the repository FIEDLER_RESISTANCE_TRIPARTITE_OPTIMIZER, Lemma 2.1 and Theorem 3.2; no external open-problem or novelty claim is made.
+
+**Definition 1.1 (The three original labelled intervals).**
+
+$$\forall a \in \mathrm{Nat},\; \forall b \in \mathrm{Nat},\; \forall c \in \mathrm{Nat},\; \forall i \in \operatorname{Fin}\left(a + b + c\right),\; \operatorname{part}\left(a, b, c, i\right) = \operatorname{ite}\left(\operatorname{val}\left(i\right) < a, 0, \operatorname{ite}\left(\operatorname{val}\left(i\right) < a + b, 1, 2\right)\right)$$
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceTripartiteOptimizer.part` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Part labels are 0,1,2. They keep all original vertices and never contract a part.
+
+**Definition 1.2 (The labelled complete tripartite graph).**
+
+$$\forall a \in \mathrm{Nat},\; \forall b \in \mathrm{Nat},\; \forall c \in \mathrm{Nat},\; \forall i \in \operatorname{Fin}\left(a + b + c\right),\; \forall j \in \operatorname{Fin}\left(a + b + c\right),\; (\operatorname{Adj}\left(\operatorname{K3}\left(a, b, c\right), i, j\right)) \Leftrightarrow (\neg (\operatorname{part}\left(a, b, c, i\right) = \operatorname{part}\left(a, b, c, j\right)))$$

+

+  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
+  rw [hc]
+  ext i
+  rw [proj_mul,hsum]
+  rfl

+private lemma harmonic_green {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hL : (wLap G w).PosSemidef) (hB : (wLap G w + constProj n).PosDef)
+    (p q : Fin n) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
+    (∃! x, Harmonic G w p q x) ∧
+    effRes G w p q = green G w p p + green G w q q - green G w p q - green G w q p := by
+  let v := green G w *ᵥ delta p q
+  let d := v p-v q
+  have hLv : wLap G w *ᵥ v = delta p q := by
+    dsimp [v]
+    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,(green_properties hn G w hB).2.1,
+      Matrix.sub_mulVec,Matrix.one_mulVec,proj_delta,sub_zero]
+  have hd : 0 < d := by
+    have h := (green_properties hn G w hB).1.dotProduct_mulVec_pos (delta_ne hpq)
+    simpa only [star_trivial,delta_dot] using h
+  let h : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (v i-v q)/d
+  have hLp : wLap G w *ᵥ h = d⁻¹ • delta p q := by
+    have he : h=d⁻¹ • (v-v q • (1 : Fin n → ℝ)) := by
+      ext i; simp [h,div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm]
+    rw [he,Matrix.mulVec_smul,Matrix.mulVec_sub,Matrix.mulVec_smul,
+      lap_one,smul_zero,sub_zero,hLv]
+  have hh : Harmonic G w p q h := by
+    refine ⟨div_self hd.ne',by simp [h],?_⟩
+    intro k hkp hkq
+    rw [hLp]
+    simp [delta,hkp,hkq]
+  have he : harmonicExt G w p q=h := by
+    unfold harmonicExt
+    rw [dif_pos ⟨h,hh⟩]
+    exact harmonic_unique hn G w hL hB p q _ h (Classical.choose_spec _) hh
+  refine ⟨⟨h,hh,fun y hy => harmonic_unique hn G w hL hB p q y h hy hh⟩,?_⟩
+  rw [effRes,if_neg hpq,he,hLp]
+  simp only [Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,delta,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.single_eq_same,
+    Pi.single_eq_of_ne hpq,mul_one,sub_zero,one_div,inv_inv]
+  dsimp [d,v]
+  simp only [delta,Matrix.mulVec_sub,Matrix.mulVec_single_one,Matrix.col_apply,Pi.sub_apply]
+  ring
+
+private lemma resistance_trace {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hL : (wLap G w).PosSemidef) (hB : (wLap G w + constProj n).PosDef) :
+    totalRes G w = n * ((green G w).trace-1) := by
+  have he (p q : Fin n) : effRes G w p q =
+      green G w p p+green G w q q-green G w p q-green G w q p := by
+    by_cases hpq : p=q
+    · subst q; simp [effRes]
+    · exact (harmonic_green hn G w hL hB p q hpq).2
+  have hp (p q : Fin n) : pairRes G w s(p,q) =
+      green G w p p+green G w q q-green G w p q-green G w q p := by
+    simp only [pairRes,Sym2.lift_mk,he]
+    rcases le_total p q with hpq | hqp
+    · rw [min_eq_left hpq,max_eq_right hpq]
+    · rw [min_eq_right hqp,max_eq_left hqp]; ring
+  let f := fun p q => green G w p p+green G w q q-green G w p q-green G w q p
+  have hs : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).sym2 = Finset.univ := by ext p; simp
+  have ht : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).offDiag.filter fun p => p.1<p.2) =
+      (Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter (fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1<p.2) := by
+    ext p
+    simp only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_offDiag,Finset.mem_univ,
+      Finset.mem_product,true_and]
+    exact and_iff_right_of_imp fun h => ne_of_lt h
+  have htw : 2 * totalRes G w = ∑ p,∑ q,f p q := by
+    rw [totalRes,← hs,Finset.sum_sym2_filter_not_isDiag,ht]
+    simp only [Finset.sum_filter,Finset.sum_product,hp]
+    simpa only [f,Finset.sum_filter] using
+      (double_sum_lt f (by intro i j; dsimp [f]; ring) (by intro i; dsimp [f]; ring)).symm
+  have hrow (i : Fin n) : ∑ j, green G w i j = 1 := by
+    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => M i ⟨0,hn⟩)
+      (green_properties hn G w hB).2.2.2.1
+    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply,constProj,← Finset.sum_mul] at h
+    have hn0 : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
+    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (inv_ne_zero hn0)
+    simpa only [one_mul] using h
+  have hsum : (∑ p,∑ q,green G w p q)=(n:ℝ) := by simp_rw [hrow]; simp
+  have hsum' : (∑ p,∑ q,green G w q p)=(n:ℝ) := by rw [Finset.sum_comm]; exact hsum
+  dsimp [f] at htw
+  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_const,
+    Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,Finset.sum_mul,
+    ← Finset.mul_sum,hsum,hsum'] at htw
+  simp only [Matrix.trace,Matrix.diag_apply]
+  nlinarith
+
+lemma resistance_spectral {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hL : (wLap G w).PosSemidef) (hB : (wLap G w + constProj n).PosDef) :
+    totalRes G w = n * ∑ i, ((lap_hermitian G w).eigenvalues i)⁻¹ := by
+  let L := wLap G w
+  let P := constProj n
+  let T := green G w-P
+  have hLT : L*T=1-P := by
+    dsimp [L,T,P]
+    rw [mul_sub,(green_properties hn G w hB).2.1,lap_proj,sub_zero]
+  have hPT : P*T=0 := by
+    dsimp [P,T]
+    rw [mul_sub,(green_properties hn G w hB).2.2.2.2,proj_sq hn,sub_self]
+  have h := AlbrightKemenyEdgeDerivativeRefutation.reciprocalRoots_eq_trace
+    L P T (lap_hermitian G w) hLT (lap_proj G w) hPT
+  rw [AlbrightKemenyEdgeDerivativeRefutation.reciprocalRoots_eq_sum L (lap_hermitian G w)] at h
+  have hn0 : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
+  have hPtr : P.trace=1 := by simp [P,Matrix.trace,constProj,hn0]
+  rw [resistance_trace hn G w hL hB]
+  congr 1
+  rw [h]
+  dsimp [T]
+  rw [Matrix.trace_sub,hPtr]
+

+private lemma positive_kernel {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.Connected) (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hw : ∀ i j, G.Adj i j → 0 < w s(i,j)) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
+    (hx : dotProduct x (wLap G w *ᵥ x)=0) : ∃ c : ℝ, x=fun _ => c := by
+  have hsum : (∑ i, ∑ j with G.Adj i j, w s(i,j)*(x i-x j)^2)=0 := by
+    rw [← energy_double,hx,mul_zero]
+  have hnon (i j : Fin n) (hij : G.Adj i j) : 0 ≤ w s(i,j)*(x i-x j)^2 :=
+    mul_nonneg (hw i j hij).le (sq_nonneg _)
+  have hedge (i j : Fin n) (hij : G.Adj i j) : x i=x j := by
+    have hi := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun k _ =>
+      Finset.sum_nonneg fun l hl => hnon k l (Finset.mem_filter.mp hl).2)).mp hsum i (mem_univ i)
+    have hj := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun k hk =>
+      hnon i k (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2)).mp hi j (by simp [hij])
+    have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp hj).resolve_left (hw i j hij).ne'
+    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x i-x j)]
+  have hreach (i j : Fin n) (h : G.Reachable i j) : x i=x j := by
+    obtain ⟨v⟩ := h
+    induction v with
+    | nil => rfl
+    | cons ha _ ih => exact (hedge _ _ ha).trans ih
+  refine ⟨x ⟨0,hn⟩,?_⟩
+  funext i
+  exact hreach i ⟨0,hn⟩ (hG i ⟨0,hn⟩)
+
+lemma positive_shift {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.Connected) (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hw : ∀ i j, G.Adj i j → 0 < w s(i,j)) :
+    (wLap G w+constProj n).PosDef := by
+  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos ((lap_hermitian G w).add (proj_hermitian n))
+  intro x hx
+  simp only [star_trivial,Matrix.add_mulVec,dotProduct_add,proj_energy]
+  have hE : 0 ≤ dotProduct x (wLap G w *ᵥ x) := by
+    simpa only [star_trivial] using (lap_psd G w (fun i j hij => (hw i j hij).le)).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
+  have hP : 0 ≤ (∑ i,x i)^2/(n:ℝ) := by positivity
+  by_contra! h
+  have hz : dotProduct x (wLap G w *ᵥ x)=0 := by linarith
+  obtain ⟨c,rfl⟩ := positive_kernel hn G hG w hw x hz
+  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by intro hc; apply hx; ext i; exact hc
+  have hh : 0 < ((n:ℝ)*c)^2/n := by positivity
+  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul] at h
+  linarith

+private lemma projection_spectral {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hB : (wLap G w+constProj n).PosDef) :
+    let hL := lap_hermitian G w
+    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (star hL.eigenvectorUnitary) (constProj n) =
+      diagonal (fun i => if hL.eigenvalues i=0 then 1 else 0) := by
+  dsimp only
+  let hL := lap_hermitian G w
+  let f := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (star hL.eigenvectorUnitary)
+  have hfL : f (wLap G w)=diagonal hL.eigenvalues := by
+    simpa [f] using hL.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
+  have hDN := congrArg f (green_properties hn G w hB).2.1
+  have hDQ := congrArg f (lap_proj G w)
+  simp only [map_mul,map_sub,map_one,hfL] at hDN
+  simp only [map_mul,map_zero,hfL] at hDQ
+  change f (constProj n)=_
+  ext i j
+  by_cases hi : hL.eigenvalues i=0
+  · have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => M i j) hDN
+    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul,hi,zero_mul,Matrix.sub_apply] at h
+    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply,hi,ite_true,Matrix.one_apply] at ⊢ h
+    linarith
+  · have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => M i j) hDQ
+    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul,Matrix.zero_apply] at h
+    have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hi
+    simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply,hi,hz]
+
+lemma zero_count {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hB : (wLap G w+constProj n).PosDef) :
+    (univ.filter fun i => (lap_hermitian G w).eigenvalues i=0).card=1 := by
+  let hL := lap_hermitian G w
+  let f := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (star hL.eigenvectorUnitary)
+  have htr : (f (constProj n)).trace=(constProj n).trace := trace_map f _
+  rw [projection_spectral hn G w hB] at htr
+  have hn0 : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
+  simp only [Matrix.trace_diagonal,Matrix.trace,Matrix.diag_apply,constProj,
+    Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hn0] at htr
+  simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq,Finset.sum_boole] at htr
+  exact_mod_cast htr

+private lemma spectral_center {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hB : (wLap G w+constProj n).PosDef) (t : ℝ)
+    (ht : ∀ i, (lap_hermitian G w).eigenvalues i ≠ 0 →
+      t ≤ (lap_hermitian G w).eigenvalues i) :
+    (wLap G w-t • (1-constProj n)).PosSemidef := by
+  let hL := lap_hermitian G w
+  let f := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (star hL.eigenvectorUnitary)
+  have hfL : f (wLap G w)=diagonal hL.eigenvalues := by
+    simpa [f] using hL.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary
+  have hM : f (wLap G w-t • (1-constProj n))=
+      diagonal (fun i => hL.eigenvalues i-t*(1-if hL.eigenvalues i=0 then 1 else 0)) := by
+    rw [map_sub,map_smul,map_sub,map_one,hfL,projection_spectral hn G w hB]
+    ext i j
+    by_cases hij : i=j
+    · subst j; simp
+    · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply,Matrix.one_apply,hij]
+  have hpos : (f (wLap G w-t • (1-constProj n))).PosSemidef := by
+    rw [hM,Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff]
+    intro i
+    by_cases hi : hL.eigenvalues i=0
+    · simp [hi]
+    · simpa only [hi,ite_false,sub_zero,mul_one] using sub_nonneg.mpr (ht i hi)
+  simpa only [f,Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply,
+    Unitary.isUnit_coe.posSemidef_star_right_conjugate_iff] using hpos

+lemma psd_rayleigh {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
+    (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
+    (hP : (wLap G w-t • (1-constProj n)).PosSemidef)
+    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : ∑ i,x i=0) :
+    t * dotProduct x x ≤ dotProduct x (wLap G w *ᵥ x) := by
+  have hp : constProj n *ᵥ x=0 := by ext i; simp [proj_mul,hx]
+  have h := hP.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
+  simp only [star_trivial,Matrix.sub_mulVec,Matrix.smul_mulVec,Matrix.one_mulVec,hp,
+    sub_zero,dotProduct_sub,dotProduct_smul,smul_eq_mul] at h
+  linarith
+
+lemma lambda_spectral {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hL : (wLap G w).PosSemidef) (hB : (wLap G w+constProj n).PosDef) :
+    0 < lambda2 G w ∧
+    (wLap G w-lambda2 G w • (1-constProj n)).PosSemidef ∧
+    ∀ i, (lap_hermitian G w).eigenvalues i ≠ 0 →
+      lambda2 G w ≤ (lap_hermitian G w).eigenvalues i := by
+  let hM := lap_hermitian G w
+  let e := hM.eigenvalues
+  let J := univ.filter fun i => e i ≠ 0
+  have hcard : J.card=n-1 := by
+    have hc := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ) (fun i => e i=0)
+    rw [zero_count (by omega) G w hB] at hc
+    simp only [Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin] at hc
+    dsimp [J]
+    omega
+  have hJ : J.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
+  obtain ⟨i,hi,hmin⟩ := J.exists_min_image e hJ
+  have hi0 : e i ≠ 0 := (mem_filter.mp hi).2
+  have hepos : 0 < e i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hL.eigenvalues_nonneg i) (Ne.symm hi0)
+  have hmin' : ∀ j,e j ≠ 0 → e i ≤ e j := fun j hj => hmin j (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,hj⟩)
+  have hP := spectral_center (by omega) G w hB (e i) hmin'
+  let v : Fin n → ℝ := ⇑(hM.eigenvectorBasis i)
+  have hv : v ≠ 0 := (WithLp.ofLp_eq_zero 2).ne.2 (hM.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.ne_zero i)
+  have heigen : wLap G w *ᵥ v=e i • v := hM.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i
+  have hsum : ∑ j,v j=0 := by
+    have hs := lap_sum G w v
+    rw [heigen] at hs
+    simp only [Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,← Finset.mul_sum] at hs
+    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hs).resolve_left hi0
+  have hval : lambda2 G w=e i := lambda2_eq_of_rayleigh G w _
+    (fun x hx => psd_rayleigh G w (e i) hP x hx) v hv hsum heigen
+  rw [hval]
+  exact ⟨hepos,hP,hmin'⟩
+
+lemma normalized_shift {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))

+    (hL : (wLap G w).PosSemidef) (ht : lambda2 G w=1) :

+  simp only [star_trivial,Matrix.sub_mulVec,Matrix.one_mulVec,dotProduct_sub] at h
+  simp only [star_trivial,Matrix.add_mulVec,dotProduct_add]

+  Adj i j := G.Adj i j ∧ 0 < w s(i,j)

+lemma connected_of_shift {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hw : ∀ i j, G.Adj i j → 0 ≤ w s(i,j))
+    (hB : (wLap G w+constProj n).PosDef) : (support G w).Connected := by
+  classical
+  rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff]
+  refine ⟨?_,⟨⟨0,hn⟩⟩⟩
+  intro p q
+  by_contra hq
+  let x : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => if (support G w).Reachable p i then 1 else 0
+  have hxp : x p=1 := by simp [x]
+  have hxq : x q=0 := by simp [x,hq]
+  have hLx : wLap G w *ᵥ x=0 := by
+    ext i
+    rw [lap_mul]
+    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+    intro j hj
+    have hij := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
+    by_cases hwpos : 0 < w s(i,j)
+    · have hadj : (support G w).Adj i j := ⟨hij,hwpos⟩
+      have hiff : (support G w).Reachable p i ↔ (support G w).Reachable p j :=
+        ⟨fun h => h.trans hadj.reachable,fun h => h.trans hadj.symm.reachable⟩
+      simp only [x,hiff,sub_self,mul_zero]
+    · have hz : w s(i,j)=0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hwpos) (hw i j hij)
+      rw [hz,zero_mul]
+  have he := congrArg (fun z => green G w *ᵥ z) hLx
+  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,(green_properties hn G w hB).2.2.1,
+    Matrix.sub_mulVec,Matrix.one_mulVec,Matrix.mulVec_zero] at he
+  have hc := sub_eq_zero.mp he
+  have hp := congrFun hc p
+  have hq' := congrFun hc q
+  rw [hxp,proj_mul] at hp
+  rw [hxq,proj_mul] at hq'
+  linarith

+  by_contra hne

+  have hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Matrix.vecMulVec v v).col)=⊥ :=

+lemma rankone_of_spectrum {n : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ)
+    (hB : (wLap G w+constProj n).PosDef) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0<t) (j : Fin n)
+    (hj : (lap_hermitian G w).eigenvalues j=2*t)
+    (he : ∀ i,i ≠ j → (lap_hermitian G w).eigenvalues i=0 ∨

+    t*(∑ i,(r i)⁻¹) ≤ (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)-1/2 ∧
+    (t*(∑ i,(r i)⁻¹)=(Fintype.card ι:ℝ)-1/2 →
+      (∑ i,r i)=((Fintype.card ι:ℝ)+1)*t ∧
+      ∃ j,r j=2*t ∧ ∀ i,i ≠ j → r i=t) := by
+  classical
+  let q := fun i => r i/t-1
+  let Q := ∑ i,q i
+  have hrpos (i : ι) : 0<r i := lt_of_lt_of_le ht (hr i)
+  have hq (i : ι) : 0 ≤ q i := by
+    dsimp [q]
+    rw [sub_nonneg,le_div_iff₀ ht]
+    simpa using hr i
+  have hQeq : Q=(∑ i,r i)/t-(Fintype.card ι:ℝ) := by
+    simp [Q,q,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.sum_div]
+  have hQ : 1 ≤ Q := by
+    have hh : (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)+1 ≤ (∑ i,r i)/t :=
+      (le_div_iff₀ ht).mpr htrace
+    linarith
+  have hQp : 0<1+Q := by linarith
+  have hqi (i : ι) : q i ≤ Q :=
+    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hq j) (mem_univ i)
+  have hterm (i : ι) : q i/(1+Q) ≤ q i/(1+q i) :=
+    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (hq i) (by linarith [hq i]) (by linarith [hqi i])
+  have hsum : Q/(1+Q) ≤ ∑ i,q i/(1+q i) := by
+    rw [show Q/(1+Q)=∑ i,q i/(1+Q) from Finset.sum_div _ _ _]
+    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hterm i
+  have hhalf : (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ Q/(1+Q) := by
+    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num) hQp]
+    linarith
+  have hid (i : ι) : t*(r i)⁻¹=1-q i/(1+q i) := by
+    dsimp [q]
+    field_simp [ht.ne',(hrpos i).ne']
+    <;> ring
+  have htot : t*(∑ i,(r i)⁻¹)=(Fintype.card ι:ℝ)-∑ i,q i/(1+q i) := by
+    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
+    simp_rw [hid]
+    simp [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
+  refine ⟨by linarith,?_⟩
+  intro heq
+  have hfrac : (∑ i,q i/(1+q i))=(1:ℝ)/2 := by linarith
+  have hQu : Q/(1+Q) ≤ (1:ℝ)/2 := by linarith
+  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hQp (by norm_num)] at hQu
+  have hQone : Q=1 := by linarith
+  have htr : (∑ i,r i)=((Fintype.card ι:ℝ)+1)*t := by
+    rw [hQeq] at hQone
+    apply (div_eq_iff ht.ne').mp
+    linarith
+  refine ⟨htr,?_⟩
+  have hd (i : ι) : 0 ≤ q i/(1+q i)-q i/2 := by
+    apply sub_nonneg.mpr
+    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (hq i) (by linarith [hq i])
+      (by linarith [hqi i])
+  have hzero : (∑ i,(q i/(1+q i)-q i/2))=0 := by
+    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,hfrac,← Finset.sum_div]
+    change 1/2-Q/2=0
+    rw [hQone]
+    norm_num
+  have hcases (i : ι) : q i=0 ∨ q i=1 := by
+    have hi := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => hd j)).mp hzero i (mem_univ i)
+    have hp : 1+q i ≠ 0 := by linarith [hq i]
+    have he : q i*(1-q i)=0 := by
+      have heq := sub_eq_zero.mp hi
+      field_simp [hp] at heq
+      nlinarith
+    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp he with h | h
+    · exact Or.inl h
+    · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
+  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ : ∃ j,q j ≠ 0 := by
+    by_contra! h
+    have hz : Q=0 := by simp [Q,h]
+    linarith
+  have hjq : q j=1 := (hcases j).resolve_left hj
+  have hother (i : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) : q i=0 := by
+    have hz : (∑ i ∈ univ.erase j,q i)=0 := by
+      have hh := Finset.sum_erase_add univ q (mem_univ j)
+      change (∑ i ∈ univ.erase j,q i)+q j=Q at hh
+      rw [hjq,hQone] at hh
+      linarith
+    exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun k _ => hq k)).mp hz i
+      (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij,mem_univ i⟩)
+  refine ⟨j,?_,?_⟩
+  · dsimp [q] at hjq
+    exact (div_eq_iff ht.ne').mp (by linarith)
+  · intro i hij
+    have hh := hother i hij
+    dsimp [q] at hh
+    have he : r i/t=1 := by linarith
+    simpa using (div_eq_iff ht.ne').mp he

+private lemma product_ceiling {a b c : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hc : 2 ≤ c)
+    (w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ) (hL : (wLap (K3 a b c) w).PosSemidef)
+    (hB : (wLap (K3 a b c) w+constProj (a+b+c)).PosDef) :
+    lambda2 (K3 a b c) w*totalRes (K3 a b c) w ≤
+      (a+b+c:ℕ)*((a+b+c:ℕ)-(3:ℝ)/2) ∧
+    (lambda2 (K3 a b c) w*totalRes (K3 a b c) w =
+      (a+b+c:ℕ)*((a+b+c:ℕ)-(3:ℝ)/2) →
+      (wLap (K3 a b c) w).trace=(a+b+c:ℕ)*lambda2 (K3 a b c) w ∧
+      ∃ j,(lap_hermitian (K3 a b c) w).eigenvalues j=2*lambda2 (K3 a b c) w ∧
+        ∀ i,i ≠ j → (lap_hermitian (K3 a b c) w).eigenvalues i=0 ∨
+          (lap_hermitian (K3 a b c) w).eigenvalues i=lambda2 (K3 a b c) w) := by
+  classical
+  let n := a+b+c
+  let e := (lap_hermitian (K3 a b c) w).eigenvalues
+  let J := {i : Fin n // e i ≠ 0}
+  let t := lambda2 (K3 a b c) w
+  have hs := lambda_spectral (by omega) (K3 a b c) w hL hB
+  have hcard : Fintype.card J=n-1 := by
+    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
+    have hz := zero_count (by omega) (K3 a b c) w hB
+    have hh := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ) (fun i => e i=0)
+    rw [hz] at hh
+    simp only [Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin] at hh
+    dsimp [n] at ⊢ hh
+    omega
+  have hsum : (∑ i : J,e i)=(wLap (K3 a b c) w).trace := by
+    rw [(lap_hermitian (K3 a b c) w).trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
+    change (∑ i : J,e i)=∑ i,e i
+    rw [← Finset.sum_subtype (univ.filter fun i => e i ≠ 0) (by simp) e]
+    exact Finset.sum_filter_ne_zero univ
+  have hinv : (∑ i : J,(e i)⁻¹)=∑ i,(e i)⁻¹ := by
+    rw [← Finset.sum_subtype (univ.filter fun i => e i ≠ 0) (by simp) (fun i => (e i)⁻¹)]
+    simp only [Finset.sum_filter]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro i hi
+    by_cases he : e i=0 <;> simp [he]
+  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by dsimp [n]; omega
+  have hcast : (Fintype.card J:ℝ)=(n:ℝ)-1 := by
+    rw [hcard,Nat.cast_sub hn1,Nat.cast_one]
+  have htrace : ((Fintype.card J:ℝ)+1)*t ≤ ∑ i : J,e i := by
+    rw [hcast,sub_add_cancel,hsum]
+    exact trace_bound ha hb hc w t hs.2.1
+  have hrec := reciprocal_ceiling (fun i : J => e i) t hs.1
+    (fun i => hs.2.2 i i.2) htrace
+  have hR : totalRes (K3 a b c) w=(n:ℝ)*∑ i : J,(e i)⁻¹ := by
+    rw [resistance_spectral (by omega) (K3 a b c) w hL hB,hinv]
+  have hnpos : (0:ℝ)<n := by dsimp [n]; positivity
+  rw [hcast] at hrec
+  constructor
+  · rw [hR]
+    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrec.1 hnpos.le]
+  · intro heq
+    have he : t*(∑ i : J,(e i)⁻¹)=(n:ℝ)-1-1/2 := by
+      rw [hR] at heq
+      change t*((n:ℝ)*∑ i : J,(e i)⁻¹)=(n:ℝ)*((n:ℝ)-3/2) at heq
+      nlinarith
+    obtain ⟨htr,j,hj,hother⟩ := hrec.2 he
+    refine ⟨?_,j.val,hj,?_⟩
+    · rw [hsum] at htr
+      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using htr
+    · intro i hij
+      by_cases hi : e i=0
+      · exact Or.inl hi
+      · exact Or.inr (hother ⟨i,hi⟩ (by intro h; exact hij (congrArg Subtype.val h)))
+

+private lemma trace_equal_kernels {a b c : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hc : 2 ≤ c)
+    (w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
+    (hP : (wLap (K3 a b c) w-t • (1-constProj (a+b+c))).PosSemidef)
+    (htr : (wLap (K3 a b c) w).trace=(a+b+c:ℕ)*t) :
+    (∀ i j,(wLap (K3 a b c) w-t • (1-constProj (a+b+c))) *ᵥ delta (va a b c i) (va a b c j)=0) ∧
+    (∀ i j,(wLap (K3 a b c) w-t • (1-constProj (a+b+c))) *ᵥ delta (vb a b c i) (vb a b c j)=0) ∧
+    (∀ i j,(wLap (K3 a b c) w-t • (1-constProj (a+b+c))) *ᵥ delta (vc a b c i) (vc a b c j)=0) := by
+  have hAI : Function.Injective (va a b c) := by intro i j h; exact Fin.ext (by simpa [va,Fin.ext_iff] using h)
+  have hBI : Function.Injective (vb a b c) := by intro i j h; exact Fin.ext (by simpa [vb,Fin.ext_iff] using h)
+  have hCI : Function.Injective (vc a b c) := by intro i j h; exact Fin.ext (by simpa [vc,Fin.ext_iff] using h)
+  have hAN : ∀ i j,¬ (K3 a b c).Adj (va a b c i) (va a b c j) := by intro i j; simp [K3,part_va]
+  have hBN : ∀ i j,¬ (K3 a b c).Adj (vb a b c i) (vb a b c j) := by intro i j; simp [K3,part_vb]
+  have hCN : ∀ i j,¬ (K3 a b c).Adj (vc a b c i) (vc a b c j) := by intro i j; simp [K3,part_vc]
+  have hAt := independent_trace ha (K3 a b c) w (va a b c) hAI hAN t hP
+  have hBt := independent_trace hb (K3 a b c) w (vb a b c) hBI hBN t hP
+  have hCt := independent_trace hc (K3 a b c) w (vc a b c) hCI hCN t hP
+  change (∑ i,wLap (K3 a b c) w i i)=(a+b+c:ℕ)*t at htr
+  rw [sum_parts] at htr
+  push_cast at htr
+  exact ⟨independent_annihilation _ w _ hAI hAN t hP (by linarith),
+    independent_annihilation _ w _ hBI hBN t hP (by linarith),
+    independent_annihilation _ w _ hCI hCN t hP (by linarith)⟩
+
+private lemma kernel_of_pairs {n m : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
+    (f : Fin m → Fin n) (j : Fin m) (hkill : ∀ i j,Q *ᵥ delta (f i) (f j)=0)
+    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hsupport : ∀ k,k ∉ Set.range f → x k=0) (hsum : ∑ k,x k=0) :
+    Q *ᵥ x=0 := by
+  ext k
+  change (∑ l,Q k l*x l)=0
+  calc
+    _=∑ l,Q k (f j)*x l := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro l hl
+      by_cases hr : l ∈ Set.range f
+      · obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := hr
+        have hh := congrFun (hkill i j) k
+        simp only [delta,Matrix.mulVec_sub,Matrix.mulVec_single_one,Matrix.col_apply,
+          Pi.sub_apply,Pi.zero_apply] at hh
+        rw [sub_eq_zero.mp hh]
+      · rw [hsupport l hr,mul_zero,mul_zero]
+    _=Q k (f j)*(∑ l,x l) := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
+    _=0 := by rw [hsum,mul_zero]

+private lemma rankone_constant {n m : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0<t)
+    (v : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : dotProduct v v=1)
+    (hQ : wLap G w-t • (1-constProj n)=t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)
+    (f : Fin m → Fin n)
+    (hkill : ∀ i j,(wLap G w-t • (1-constProj n)) *ᵥ delta (f i) (f j)=0) :
+    ∀ i j,v (f i)=v (f j) := by
+  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ : ∃ k,v k ≠ 0 := by
+    by_contra! h
+    have hz : v=0 := funext h
+    simp [hz] at hv
+  intro i j
+  have hh := congrFun (hkill i j) k
+  rw [hQ,Matrix.smul_mulVec,Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec] at hh
+  simp only [Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,Pi.zero_apply,dotProduct_comm v,
+    delta_dot,op_smul_eq_mul] at hh
+  have : t*v k*(v (f i)-v (f j))=0 := by nlinarith only [hh]
+  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero ht.ne' hk))
+
+private lemma rankone_square {n m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0<t)
+    (v : Fin n → ℝ) (hQ : wLap G w-t • (1-constProj n)=t • Matrix.vecMulVec v v)
+    (f : Fin m → Fin n) (hf : Function.Injective f)
+    (hI : ∀ i j,¬ G.Adj (f i) (f j)) (hconst : ∀ i j,v (f i)=v (f j)) :
+    (v (f ⟨0,by omega⟩))^2=(n:ℝ)⁻¹ := by
+  let i : Fin m := ⟨0,by omega⟩
+  let j : Fin m := ⟨1,by omega⟩
+  have hij : f i ≠ f j := hf.ne (by simp [i,j,Fin.ext_iff])
+  have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => M (f i) (f j)) hQ
+  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply,Matrix.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,Matrix.one_apply,
+    if_neg hij,zero_sub,constProj,Matrix.vecMulVec_apply] at hh
+  rw [hconst j i] at hh
+  have hL : wLap G w (f i) (f j)=0 := by simp [wLap,hij,hI]
+  rw [hL] at hh
+  change (v (f i))^2=(n:ℝ)⁻¹
+  nlinarith
+
+private lemma equality_coordinates {a b c : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
+    (w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ) (hL : (wLap (K3 a b c) w).PosSemidef)
+    (hB : (wLap (K3 a b c) w+constProj (a+b+c)).PosDef)
+    (heq : lambda2 (K3 a b c) w*totalRes (K3 a b c) w =
+      (a+b+c:ℕ)*((a+b+c:ℕ)-(3:ℝ)/2)) :
+    c=a+b ∧ ∀ i j,(K3 a b c).Adj i j →
+      w s(i,j)=if part a b c i=2 ∨ part a b c j=2 then
+        lambda2 (K3 a b c) w/c else 0 := by
+  classical
+  let n := a+b+c
+  let G := K3 a b c
+  let t := lambda2 G w
+  have hb : 2 ≤ b := le_trans ha hab
+  have hc : 2 ≤ c := le_trans hb hbc
+  have hs := lambda_spectral (by omega) G w hL hB
+  have ht : 0<t := hs.1
+  have hP : (wLap G w-t • (1-constProj n)).PosSemidef := hs.2.1
+  obtain ⟨htr,j,hj,hother⟩ := (product_ceiling ha hb hc w hL hB).2 heq
+  obtain ⟨v,hvsum,hvnorm,hQ,hrank⟩ := rankone_of_spectrum (by omega) G w hB t ht j hj hother
+  have hAI : Function.Injective (va a b c) := by
+    intro i j h; exact Fin.ext (by simpa [va,Fin.ext_iff] using h)
+  have hBI : Function.Injective (vb a b c) := by
+    intro i j h; exact Fin.ext (by simpa [vb,Fin.ext_iff] using h)
+  have hCI : Function.Injective (vc a b c) := by
+    intro i j h; exact Fin.ext (by simpa [vc,Fin.ext_iff] using h)
+  have hAN : ∀ i j,¬ G.Adj (va a b c i) (va a b c j) := by
+    intro i j; simp [G,K3,part_va]
+  have hBN : ∀ i j,¬ G.Adj (vb a b c i) (vb a b c j) := by
+    intro i j; simp [G,K3,part_vb]
+  have hCN : ∀ i j,¬ G.Adj (vc a b c i) (vc a b c j) := by
+    intro i j; simp [G,K3,part_vc]
+  have hkill := trace_equal_kernels ha hb hc w t hP htr
+  have hAc := rankone_constant G w t ht v hvnorm hQ (va a b c) hkill.1
+  have hBc := rankone_constant G w t ht v hvnorm hQ (vb a b c) hkill.2.1
+  have hCc := rankone_constant G w t ht v hvnorm hQ (vc a b c) hkill.2.2
+  let α := v (va a b c ⟨0,by omega⟩)
+  let β := v (vb a b c ⟨0,by omega⟩)
+  let γ := v (vc a b c ⟨0,by omega⟩)
+  have hα : α^2=(n:ℝ)⁻¹ := rankone_square ha G w t ht v hQ (va a b c) hAI hAN hAc
+  have hβ : β^2=(n:ℝ)⁻¹ := rankone_square hb G w t ht v hQ (vb a b c) hBI hBN hBc
+  have hγ : γ^2=(n:ℝ)⁻¹ := rankone_square hc G w t ht v hQ (vc a b c) hCI hCN hCc
+  have hα0 : α ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    have hn : (0:ℝ)<n := by dsimp [n]; positivity
+    rw [h,zero_pow (by decide)] at hα
+    exact (ne_of_gt (inv_pos.mpr hn)) hα.symm
+  have hbal : (a:ℝ)*α+b*β+c*γ=0 := by
+    rw [sum_parts] at hvsum
+    simp_rw [hAc _ ⟨0,by omega⟩,hBc _ ⟨0,by omega⟩,hCc _ ⟨0,by omega⟩] at hvsum
+    simpa only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,α,β,γ] using hvsum
+  have hbsgn : β=α ∨ β=-α := (sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg).mp (hβ.trans hα.symm)
+  have hcsgn : γ=α ∨ γ=-α := (sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg).mp (hγ.trans hα.symm)
+  have hsign : β=α ∧ γ=-α ∧ c=a+b := by
+    have haR : (0:ℝ)<a := by positivity
+    have hbR : (0:ℝ)<b := by positivity
+    have hcR : (0:ℝ)<c := by positivity
+    have habR : (a:ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hab
+    have hbcR : (b:ℝ) ≤ c := by exact_mod_cast hbc
+    rcases hbsgn with hbsgn | hbsgn <;> rcases hcsgn with hcsgn | hcsgn
+    · rw [hbsgn,hcsgn] at hbal
+      have : ((a:ℝ)+b+c)*α=0 := by linear_combination hbal
+      have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hα0
+      linarith only [hz,haR,hbR,hcR,habR,hbcR]
+    · refine ⟨hbsgn,hcsgn,?_⟩
+      rw [hbsgn,hcsgn] at hbal
+      have : ((a:ℝ)+b-c)*α=0 := by linear_combination hbal
+      have hh := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hα0
+      exact_mod_cast (show (c:ℝ)=a+b by linarith only [hh])
+    · rw [hbsgn,hcsgn] at hbal
+      have : ((a:ℝ)-b+c)*α=0 := by linear_combination hbal
+      have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hα0
+      linarith only [hz,haR,hbR,hcR,habR,hbcR]
+    · rw [hbsgn,hcsgn] at hbal
+      have : ((a:ℝ)-b-c)*α=0 := by linear_combination hbal
+      have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hα0
+      linarith only [hz,haR,hbR,hcR,habR,hbcR]
+  have hv (i : Fin n) : v i=if part a b c i=2 then -α else α := by
+    by_cases hi : i.val<a
+    · have he : i=va a b c ⟨i.val,hi⟩ := by apply Fin.ext; rfl
+      rw [he,hAc _ ⟨0,by omega⟩,part_va]
+      rfl
+    · by_cases hib : i.val<a+b
+      · let k : Fin b := ⟨i.val-a,by omega⟩
+        have he : i=vb a b c k := by apply Fin.ext; dsimp [vb,k]; omega
+        rw [he,hBc _ ⟨0,by omega⟩,part_vb]
+        simpa only [if_neg (by decide : ¬ (1:ℕ)=2)] using hsign.1
+      · let k : Fin c := ⟨i.val-(a+b),by have := i.isLt; dsimp [n] at this; omega⟩
+        have he : i=vc a b c k := by apply Fin.ext; dsimp [vc,k]; omega
+        rw [he,hCc _ ⟨0,by omega⟩,part_vc]
+        simpa using hsign.2.1
+  refine ⟨hsign.2.2,?_⟩
+  intro i k hik
+  change G.Adj i k at hik
+  change w s(i,k)=(if part a b c i=2 ∨ part a b c k=2 then t/c else 0)
+  have hne : i ≠ k := G.ne_of_adj hik
+  have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => M i k) hQ
+  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply,Matrix.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,Matrix.one_apply,
+    if_neg hne,zero_sub,constProj,Matrix.vecMulVec_apply] at hh
+  have hLoff : wLap G w i k= -w s(i,k) := by simp [wLap,hne,hik]
+  rw [hLoff,hv i,hv k] at hh
+  change -w s(i,k)-t* -(n:ℝ)⁻¹=t*((if part a b c i=2 then -α else α)*(if part a b c k=2 then -α else α)) at hh
+  have hnC : (n:ℝ)=2*c := by dsimp [n]; rw [hsign.2.2]; push_cast; ring
+  have hc0 : (c:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
+  have hinv : (n:ℝ)⁻¹=1/(2*c) := by rw [hnC]; simp
+  have hsq : α*α=(n:ℝ)⁻¹ := by nlinarith only [hα]
+  by_cases hi : part a b c i=2 <;> by_cases hk : part a b c k=2
+  · exact (hik (hi.trans hk.symm)).elim
+  · simp only [hi,hk,↓reduceIte,true_or] at hh ⊢
+    rw [hinv] at hsq hh
+    field_simp [hc0] at hsq hh ⊢
+    rw [hsq,one_mul] at hh
+    nlinarith only [hh]
+  · simp only [hi,hk,↓reduceIte,or_true] at hh ⊢
+    rw [hinv] at hsq hh
+    field_simp [hc0] at hsq hh ⊢
+    rw [hsq,one_mul] at hh
+    nlinarith only [hh]
+  · simp only [hi,hk,↓reduceIte,false_or] at hh ⊢
+    rw [hsq] at hh
+    linarith only [hh]

+/-- Zero extension of the normalized balanced boundary on original unordered pairs. -/
+def boundary (a b c : ℕ) : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ :=
+  Sym2.lift ⟨fun i j => if (part a b c i=2) ≠ (part a b c j=2) then (c:ℝ)⁻¹ else 0,
+    by intro i j; by_cases hi : part a b c i=2 <;> by_cases hj : part a b c j=2 <;> simp [hi,hj]⟩
+
+private def signs (a b c : ℕ) (i : Fin (a+b+c)) : ℝ :=
+  if part a b c i=2 then -1 else 1
+
+private lemma signs_sum {a b c : ℕ} (hbal : c=a+b) :
+    (∑ i,signs a b c i)=0 := by
+  rw [sum_parts]
+  simp [signs,part_va,part_vb,part_vc,hbal]
+
+private lemma signs_sq {a b c : ℕ} : dotProduct (signs a b c) (signs a b c)=(a+b+c:ℕ) := by
+  simp only [dotProduct]
+  have hh (i : Fin (a+b+c)) : signs a b c i*signs a b c i=1 := by
+    simp [signs]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
+  simp_rw [hh]
+  simp
+
+private lemma boundary_matrix {a b c : ℕ} (hc : 0<c) (hbal : c=a+b) :
+    wLap (K3 a b c) (boundary a b c)=1-constProj (a+b+c)+
+      ((a+b+c:ℕ):ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec (signs a b c) (signs a b c) := by
+  let n := a+b+c
+  let M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := 1-constProj n+
+    (n:ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec (signs a b c) (signs a b c)
+  have hn : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by dsimp [n]; positivity
+  have hnC : (n:ℝ)=2*c := by dsimp [n]; rw [hbal]; push_cast; ring
+  have hM : M *ᵥ (1 : Fin n → ℝ)=0 := by
+    ext i
+    simp [M,Matrix.add_mulVec,Matrix.sub_mulVec,Matrix.smul_mulVec,
+      Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec,Matrix.one_mulVec,proj_mul,dotProduct,signs_sum hbal,hn]
+    exact Or.inr (signs_sum hbal)
+  have hoff (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) : wLap (K3 a b c) (boundary a b c) i j=M i j := by
+    dsimp [M]
+    simp only [wLap,if_neg hij,Matrix.add_apply,Matrix.sub_apply,Matrix.one_apply,
+      if_neg hij,zero_sub,constProj,Matrix.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
+      boundary,Sym2.lift_mk,signs]
+    change (if part a b c i ≠ part a b c j then
+      -(if (part a b c i=2) ≠ (part a b c j=2) then (c:ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) else 0)=_
+    by_cases hi : part a b c i=2 <;> by_cases hj : part a b c j=2
+    · simp [hi,hj]
+    · have hp : part a b c i ≠ part a b c j := by intro h; exact hj (h ▸ hi)
+      simp [hi,hj,hp,Ne.symm hj,hnC,inv_mul_eq_div]
+      field_simp <;> ring
+    · have hp : part a b c i ≠ part a b c j := by intro h; exact hi (h.symm ▸ hj)
+      simp [hi,hj,hp,Ne.symm hi,hnC,inv_mul_eq_div]
+      field_simp <;> ring
+    · simp [hi,hj]
+  ext i j
+  by_cases hij : i=j
+  · subst j
+    have hL := congrFun (lap_one (K3 a b c) (boundary a b c)) i
+    have hMi := congrFun hM i
+    simp only [Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,Pi.one_apply,mul_one,Pi.zero_apply] at hL hMi
+    have hsum : (∑ j,(wLap (K3 a b c) (boundary a b c) i j-M i j))=0 := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,hL,hMi,sub_self]
+    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i] at hsum
+    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsum
+    · intro k hk hki; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hoff i k hki.symm)
+    · simp
+  · exact hoff i j hij
+
+private lemma boundary_nonneg {a b c : ℕ} :
+    ∀ i j,(K3 a b c).Adj i j → 0 ≤ boundary a b c s(i,j) := by
+  intro i j hij
+  simp only [boundary,Sym2.lift_mk]
+  split_ifs <;> positivity
+
+private lemma boundary_lambda {a b c : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hc : 0<c) (hbal : c=a+b) :
+    lambda2 (K3 a b c) (boundary a b c)=1 := by
+  have hM := boundary_matrix hc hbal
+  have hP : (wLap (K3 a b c) (boundary a b c)-(1-constProj (a+b+c))).PosSemidef := by
+    rw [hM,add_sub_cancel_left]
+    have hv : (Matrix.vecMulVec (signs a b c) (signs a b c)).PosSemidef := by
+      simpa only [star_trivial] using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (signs a b c)
+    exact hv.smul (by positivity)
+  let i := va a b c ⟨0,by omega⟩
+  let j := va a b c ⟨1,by omega⟩
+  have hij : i ≠ j := by simp [i,j,va,Fin.ext_iff]
+  refine lambda2_eq_of_rayleigh _ _ 1
+    (fun x hx => by simpa using psd_rayleigh _ _ 1 (by simpa using hP) x hx)
+    (delta i j) (delta_ne hij) (delta_sum _ _) ?_
+  rw [hM,Matrix.add_mulVec,Matrix.sub_mulVec,Matrix.one_mulVec,proj_delta,
+    sub_zero,Matrix.smul_mulVec,Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec]
+  have hz : dotProduct (signs a b c) (delta i j)=0 := by
+    rw [dotProduct_comm,delta_dot]
+    simp [i,j,signs,part_va]
+  simp [hz]

+/-- Multiplicities of the actual native Hermitian Laplacian eigenvalues. -/
+def FullSpectrum {a b c : ℕ} (w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
+  let e := (lap_hermitian (K3 a b c) w).eigenvalues
+  (univ.filter fun i => e i=0).card=1 ∧
+  (univ.filter fun i => e i=1).card=a+b+c-2 ∧
+  (univ.filter fun i => e i=2).card=1 ∧
+  ∀ i,e i=0 ∨ e i=1 ∨ e i=2
+
+private lemma boundary_spectrum {a b c : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hc : 0<c) (hbal : c=a+b) :
+    FullSpectrum (boundary a b c) ∧
+    totalRes (K3 a b c) (boundary a b c)=(a+b+c:ℕ)*((a+b+c:ℕ)-(3:ℝ)/2) := by
+  classical
+  let n := a+b+c
+  let G := K3 a b c
+  let w := boundary a b c
+  let σ := signs a b c
+  let e := (lap_hermitian G w).eigenvalues
+  have hn : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by dsimp [n]; positivity
+  have hM := boundary_matrix hc hbal
+  change wLap G w=1-constProj n+(n:ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec σ σ at hM
+  have hL := lap_psd G w boundary_nonneg
+  have hB := normalized_shift (by omega) G w hL (boundary_lambda ha hc hbal)
+  have hzero : (univ.filter fun i => e i=0).card=1 := zero_count (by omega) G w hB
+  have hLs : wLap G w *ᵥ σ=(2:ℝ) • σ := by
+    rw [hM,Matrix.add_mulVec,Matrix.sub_mulVec,Matrix.one_mulVec,
+      Matrix.smul_mulVec,Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec]
+    have hp : constProj n *ᵥ σ=0 := by
+      ext i; simp only [proj_mul,Pi.zero_apply]
+      rw [show (∑ i,σ i)=0 from signs_sum hbal]; simp
+    rw [hp,sub_zero]
+    ext i
+    simp only [Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,op_smul_eq_mul,σ,signs_sq]
+    change σ i+(n:ℝ)⁻¹*(σ i*(n:ℝ))=2*σ i
+    field_simp
+    <;> ring
+  have hcases (i : Fin n) : e i=0 ∨ e i=1 ∨ e i=2 := by
+    by_cases hi0 : e i=0
+    · exact Or.inl hi0
+    by_cases hi2 : e i=2
+    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hi2)
+    let x : Fin n → ℝ := ⇑((lap_hermitian G w).eigenvectorBasis i)
+    have hx : x ≠ 0 := (WithLp.ofLp_eq_zero 2).ne.2
+      ((lap_hermitian G w).eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.ne_zero i)
+    have he : wLap G w *ᵥ x=e i • x := (lap_hermitian G w).mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i
+    have hsum : (∑ k,x k)=0 := by
+      have hh := lap_sum G w x
+      rw [he] at hh
+      simp only [Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,← Finset.mul_sum] at hh
+      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hh).resolve_left hi0
+    have hd : dotProduct σ x=0 := by
+      have hh := (lap_hermitian G w).star_dotProduct_mulVec_comm σ x
+      simp only [star_trivial,he,hLs,dotProduct_smul,smul_eq_mul] at hh
+      rw [dotProduct_comm x σ] at hh
+      have hz : (e i-2)*dotProduct σ x=0 := by linear_combination hh
+      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hi2)
+    have hxL : wLap G w *ᵥ x=x := by
+      rw [hM,Matrix.add_mulVec,Matrix.sub_mulVec,Matrix.one_mulVec,
+        Matrix.smul_mulVec,Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec,hd]
+      have hp : constProj n *ᵥ x=0 := by ext k; simp [proj_mul,hsum]
+      simp [hp]
+    obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ : ∃ k,x k ≠ 0 := by
+      by_contra! h; exact hx (funext h)
+    have hh := congrFun (he.symm.trans hxL) k
+    simp only [Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul] at hh
+    have hz : (e i-1)*x k=0 := by linear_combination hh
+    exact Or.inr (Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right hk)))
+  have htrace : (wLap G w).trace=(n:ℝ) := by
+    rw [hM,Matrix.trace_add,Matrix.trace_sub,Matrix.trace_one,Matrix.trace_smul,
+      Matrix.trace_vecMulVec]
+    rw [show dotProduct σ σ=(n:ℝ) from signs_sq]
+    have hp : (constProj n).trace=1 := by simp [Matrix.trace,constProj,hn]
+    rw [hp]
+    simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
+    change (n:ℝ)-1+(n:ℝ)⁻¹*(n:ℝ)=(n:ℝ)
+    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hn]
+    ring
+  let o := (univ.filter fun i => e i=1).card
+  let d := (univ.filter fun i => e i=2).card
+  have hcount : (1:ℝ)+o+d=n := by
+    have hh : (∑ i : Fin n,((if e i=0 then (1:ℝ) else 0)+
+        (if e i=1 then 1 else 0)+(if e i=2 then 1 else 0)))=n := by
+      calc
+        _=∑ i : Fin n,(1:ℝ) := by
+          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+          intro i hi
+          rcases hcases i with h | h | h <;> simp [h]
+        _=_ := by simp
+    have hh' : ((univ.filter fun i => e i=0).card:ℝ)+o+d=n := by
+      simpa [Finset.sum_add_distrib,o,d] using hh
+    rw [hzero] at hh'
+    simpa using hh'
+  have hsum : (o:ℝ)+2*d=n := by
+    have hh : (∑ i : Fin n,e i)=
+        ∑ i : Fin n,((if e i=1 then (1:ℝ) else 0)+2*(if e i=2 then 1 else 0)) := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro i hi
+      rcases hcases i with h | h | h <;> simp [h]
+    have htrace' := htrace
+    rw [(lap_hermitian G w).trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues] at htrace'
+    change (∑ i,e i)=(n:ℝ) at htrace'
+    rw [htrace'] at hh
+    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum] at hh
+    simpa only [Finset.sum_boole] using hh.symm
+  have hdR : (d:ℝ)=1 := by linarith only [hcount,hsum]
+  have hd : d=1 := by exact_mod_cast hdR
+  have hoR : (o:ℝ)=(n:ℝ)-2 := by linarith only [hsum,hdR]
+  have ho : o=n-2 := by
+    have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by dsimp [n]; omega
+    exact_mod_cast (show (o:ℝ)=((n-2:ℕ):ℝ) by simpa [Nat.cast_sub hn2] using hoR)
+  refine ⟨⟨hzero,ho,hd,hcases⟩,?_⟩
+  rw [resistance_spectral (by omega) G w hL hB]
+  have hinv : (∑ i : Fin n,(e i)⁻¹)=(n:ℝ)-3/2 := by
+    have hh : (∑ i : Fin n,(e i)⁻¹)=
+        ∑ i : Fin n,((if e i=1 then (1:ℝ) else 0)+(1/2)*(if e i=2 then 1 else 0)) := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro i hi
+      rcases hcases i with h | h | h <;> norm_num [h]
+    rw [hh]
+    have hh' : (∑ i : Fin n,((if e i=1 then (1:ℝ) else 0)+(1/2)*(if e i=2 then 1 else 0)))=
+        (o:ℝ)+(1/2)*d := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum]
+      simp only [Finset.sum_boole]
+      rfl
+    rw [hh',hdR,hoR]
+    ring
+  change (n:ℝ)*(∑ i,(e i)⁻¹)=(n:ℝ)*((n:ℝ)-3/2)
+  rw [hinv]
+

+private lemma boundary_edges {a b c : ℕ} (i j : Fin (a+b+c)) (hij : (K3 a b c).Adj i j) :
+    boundary a b c s(i,j)=if part a b c i=2 ∨ part a b c j=2 then 1/(c:ℝ) else 0 := by
+  by_cases hi : part a b c i=2 <;> by_cases hj : part a b c j=2
+  · exact (hij (hi.trans hj.symm)).elim
+  · simp [boundary,Sym2.lift_mk,hi,hj,one_div]
+  · simp [boundary,Sym2.lift_mk,hi,hj,one_div]
+  · simp [boundary,Sym2.lift_mk,hi,hj]

+/-- The trace excess and the three full independent-part kernel spaces. -/
+def Compression {a b c : ℕ} (w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
+  let H := wLap (K3 a b c) w-(1-constProj (a+b+c))
+  H.PosSemidef ∧ H *ᵥ (1 : Fin (a+b+c) → ℝ)=0 ∧ 1 ≤ H.trace ∧
+    (H.trace=1 → ∀ r ∈ ({0,1,2} : Finset ℕ),∀ x : Fin (a+b+c) → ℝ,
+      (∑ i,x i)=0 → (∀ i,part a b c i ≠ r → x i=0) → H *ᵥ x=0)
+
+private lemma compression_normalized {a b c : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hc : 2 ≤ c)
+    (w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i j,(K3 a b c).Adj i j → 0 ≤ w s(i,j))
+    (ht : lambda2 (K3 a b c) w=1) : Compression w := by
+  classical
+  let n := a+b+c
+  let H := wLap (K3 a b c) w-(1-constProj n)
+  have hn : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by dsimp [n]; positivity
+  have hL := lap_psd _ w hw
+  have hB := normalized_shift (by omega) _ w hL ht
+  have hP : H.PosSemidef := by simpa [ht,H] using (lambda_spectral (by omega) _ w hL hB).2.1
+  have htr : H.trace=(wLap (K3 a b c) w).trace-(n:ℝ)+1 := by
+    simp only [H,Matrix.trace_sub,Matrix.trace_one,Fintype.card_fin]
+    have hp : (constProj n).trace=1 := by simp [Matrix.trace,constProj,hn]
+    rw [hp]; ring
+  have hbound := trace_bound ha hb hc w 1 (by simpa [H] using hP)
+  refine ⟨hP,?_,by dsimp [n] at htr; simpa only [mul_one] using (by linarith only [htr,hbound] : 1 ≤ H.trace),?_⟩
+  · have hp : constProj n *ᵥ (1 : Fin n → ℝ)=1 := by
+      ext i
+      simp only [proj_mul,Pi.one_apply,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,
+        Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one,div_self hn]
+    simp only [H,Matrix.sub_mulVec,Matrix.one_mulVec,lap_one]
+    rw [show constProj (a+b+c) *ᵥ (1 : Fin (a+b+c) → ℝ)=1 from hp]
+    simp
+  · intro he r hr x hsum hsupp
+    have hlt : (wLap (K3 a b c) w).trace=(n:ℝ) := by linarith only [htr,he]
+    have hkill := trace_equal_kernels ha hb hc w 1 (by simpa [H] using hP) (by simpa only [mul_one] using hlt)
+    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hr
+    rcases hr with rfl | rfl | rfl
+    · apply kernel_of_pairs H (va a b c) ⟨0,by omega⟩ (by simpa [H] using hkill.1) x ?_ hsum
+      intro k hk
+      apply hsupp k
+      intro hp
+      have hi : k.val<a := by unfold part at hp; split_ifs at hp <;> omega
+      exact hk ⟨⟨k.val,hi⟩,Fin.ext rfl⟩
+    · apply kernel_of_pairs H (vb a b c) ⟨0,by omega⟩ (by simpa [H] using hkill.2.1) x ?_ hsum
+      intro k hk
+      apply hsupp k
+      intro hp
+      have hi : a ≤ k.val ∧ k.val<a+b := by unfold part at hp; split_ifs at hp <;> omega
+      refine hk ⟨⟨k.val-a,by omega⟩,?_⟩
+      apply Fin.ext; dsimp [vb]; omega
+    · apply kernel_of_pairs H (vc a b c) ⟨0,by omega⟩ (by simpa [H] using hkill.2.2) x ?_ hsum
+      intro k hk
+      apply hsupp k
+      intro hp
+      have hi : a+b ≤ k.val := by unfold part at hp; split_ifs at hp <;> omega
+      refine hk ⟨⟨k.val-(a+b),by have := k.isLt; omega⟩,?_⟩
+      apply Fin.ext; dsimp [vc]; omega
+
+/-- The complete original tripartite endpoint, with uniqueness only on actual edges. -/
+def Theorem32 (a b c : ℕ) : Prop :=
+  let G := K3 a b c
+  let U := (a+b+c:ℕ)*((a+b+c:ℕ)-(3:ℝ)/2)
+  (∀ w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ, (∀ i j,G.Adj i j → 0<w s(i,j)) →
+    0<lambda2 G w ∧ lambda2 G w*totalRes G w<U) ∧
+  (∀ w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ, (∀ i j,G.Adj i j → 0 ≤ w s(i,j)) →
+    lambda2 G w=1 → (support G w).Connected ∧ totalRes G w ≤ U ∧
+      (totalRes G w=U ↔ c=a+b ∧ ∀ i j,G.Adj i j → w s(i,j)=boundary a b c s(i,j))) ∧
+  ((∃ w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ, (∀ i j,G.Adj i j → 0 ≤ w s(i,j)) ∧
+    lambda2 G w=1 ∧ totalRes G w=U) ↔ c=a+b) ∧
+  (c=a+b → (∀ i j,G.Adj i j → 0 ≤ boundary a b c s(i,j)) ∧
+    (support G (boundary a b c)).Connected ∧ lambda2 G (boundary a b c)=1 ∧
+    totalRes G (boundary a b c)=U ∧ FullSpectrum (boundary a b c) ∧
+    ¬ (∀ i j,G.Adj i j → 0<boundary a b c s(i,j))) ∧
+  (∀ w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ, (∀ i j,G.Adj i j → 0 ≤ w s(i,j)) →
+    lambda2 G w=1 → Compression w ∧
+      (totalRes G w=U → (wLap G w-(1-constProj (a+b+c))).rank=1))
+
+/-- Universal strict product bound and the unique balanced normalized boundary. -/
+theorem result {a b c : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
+    Theorem32 a b c := by
+  classical
+  let G := K3 a b c
+  let U := (a+b+c:ℕ)*((a+b+c:ℕ)-(3:ℝ)/2)
+  have hb : 2 ≤ b := le_trans ha hab
+  have hc : 2 ≤ c := le_trans hb hbc
+  have ha0 : 0<a := by omega
+  have hc0 : 0<c := by omega
+  let i := va a b c ⟨0,ha0⟩
+  let j := vb a b c ⟨0,by omega⟩
+  have hij : G.Adj i j := by simp [G,K3,i,j,part_va,part_vb]
+  have hbd0 : boundary a b c s(i,j)=0 := by
+    simp [boundary,Sym2.lift_mk,i,j,part_va,part_vb]
+  have hnorm (w : Sym2 (Fin (a+b+c)) → ℝ)
